title: R24 TABLESTYLE DWG writer AC1032 extension

scope.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §§20.4.101.2-.4
scope.fields: The existing modeled R24 TABLESTYLE prefix, Table cell style, three required cell styles, detached strings, and text-style/linetype hard-pointer handles.
scope.basis: ODA specifies the R24 layout; the current AC1032 parser already routes versions newer than AC1021 through that layout. A separate AC1032 ODA sample peer-tail cursor corroborates the repeated style order and IDs, but does not independently prove every field or recover the compressed-page handle-stream partition.
exclusions: physical source output binding or Cover projection
DXF schema and native consumer qualification
TABLESTYLE named-role semantics where ODA field/class descriptions conflict with observed source order

implementation.behavior: The DWG writer and payload validator now admit AC1032 for the same bounded R24 TABLESTYLE profile already supported at AC1024/AC1027. The generated control preregisters all planned class instances, checks malformed-style-count and unsupported-CMC refusal, then writes corrected data on each same handle and reads every typed payload and raw carrier back.

validation.coverage: The six-version local DWG roundtrip verifies AC1032 TABLESTYLE callback fields, three repeated styles, selected hard-pointer handles, typed/raw carrier pairing, malformed-count and invalid-CMC refusal, same-handle corrected retry after each refusal, and fresh typed readback. Inputs are generated by the existing test from scratch and are not committed.

evidenceLimit: This proves local encoder/parser and rollback consistency for the bounded modeled profile. It does not establish independent producer interoperability, all AC1032 TABLESTYLE fields, graph closure, table semantics, or consumer support.
